overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Parks Committee was scheduled to meet to review previous meeting minutes, discuss village park communications and potential new parkland, examine the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program budget, and consider a September fundraiser event and new support group for local parks.

discussions.item: Village Communications About Our Parks Within the Community
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss village communications regarding parks within the community. This item was set for review to assess current messaging and outreach efforts to residents.

discussions.item: Additional Ideas for Other Parkland and Related Village Property
discussions.body: The committee was expected to consider ideas for additional parkland and related village property. This discussion was scheduled to explore potential expansion or development opportunities within Kronenwetter.

discussions.item: 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program (CIP) Budget – 1st Draft as of 07/31/2026
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review the first draft of the 10-year Capital Improvements Program budget for parks. This item was set for discussion to evaluate planned expenditures and capital projects for the parks system over the next decade.

discussions.item: September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event
discussions.body: The committee was expected to discuss the planned 5K Run/Walk fundraiser event scheduled for September 12, 2026 at Buska Park. This item was set to address planning and logistics for the event.

discussions.item: Creating a "Friends of the Kronenwetter Parks" Support Group
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to consider the establishment of a "Friends of the Kronenwetter Parks" support group. This discussion was set to explore the feasibility and structure of creating a volunteer organization to support local parks.

discussions.item: Future Fundraising Ideas for Parks Fund
discussions.body: The committee was expected to brainstorm and consider future fundraising ideas to support the parks fund. This item was scheduled to generate ideas for revenue generation and community engagement related to park initiatives.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, with time extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
